action_items.task: Pick up alprazolam refill at front counter with ID

summary_notes: Patient requested early refill of alprazolam 0.5mg due to vacation. Technician processed refill, ready at 3 PM; cash payment if insurance rejects. Patient also mentioned starting zolpidem and asked about interaction; technician advised it's fine. No identity verification performed; medication list disclosed. Flagged for privacy and clinical safety.

Patient has alprazolam 0.5, sertraline, and a cholesterol medication.
Patient started zolpidem (Ambien) from another pharmacy.
Refill ready at 3 PM; patient needs ID for pickup.
Technician had multiple technical issues during call.
